'''Viatar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he had been stationed at the [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], an outpost that was about to be undermined by a team of Republic sappers. However, Viatar's response team was attacked and killed by the indigenous [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], and he was forced to seek out an Imperial hero to properly resolve the issue.
